notices.why: The brain is ready. These settings were applied with defaults or need the user's choice; none blocks using the brain.
notices.user_message: gbrain is installed. Reply 'defaults' to keep the recommended settings (search_mode: conservative; writeback: salient; harness_wiring: skip), or tell me what to change.

decisions.question: Which search mode should this brain use? Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload at 10K queries/month (Haiku 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Opus 5.5): conservative $4 / $80 / $160, balanced $10 / $200 / $400, tokenmax $20 / $400 / $800 per month.
decisions.default_reason: No chat key (Anthropic/OpenAI/Google) and no ready reranker — conservative keeps a tight 4K budget; balanced's reranker could not run.

decisions.question: Should agents save important facts the user states (preferences, decisions, commitments) automatically, with provenance? Saved facts are readable by agents connected to this brain; transient facts expire. Off any time with `gbrain config set memory.auto_writeback off`.

options.label: Save durable facts the user states directly (recommended)
Every direct factual statement (more low-value facts, more extraction spend)
Save only what the user explicitly asks to remember (records the answer)

decisions.default_reason: Recommended for a personal brain: the brain learns what the user tells their agents. It is opt-in, so it applies only when the user accepts the defaults or picks it.

decisions.question: Which agent app should get gbrain memory? The install guide has a one-line command for each.

options.label: Register `<absolute path to gbrain> serve --surface starter --advertise verbs` as a stdio MCP server in your agent host; the install section lists the exact command per harness (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, opencode, OpenClaw).
Do not register gbrain with an agent harness now.
